positioning.zh: 将当前对话中用户已提供的内容组织成单页信息图规格，并可按明确请求输出可复制的独立 HTML 源码。
positioning.en: Organizes user-supplied conversation content into a single-page infographic specification and, when explicitly requested, copyable standalone HTML source.

current_safe: visual-form, layout, spacing, color, typography, and accessibility guidance
placement of supplied source notes and attribution
claim inventory traced to supplied content
complete static HTML with inline CSS when explicitly requested
semantic text and coherent heading order
no external enrichment or state changes
query_clusters: organize supplied content into an infographic

include: explicit request for a one-page infographic specification
explicit request for standalone infographic HTML
explicit request to organize supplied content into an infographic layout
exclude: requests without an explicit infographic specification or standalone HTML intent
